business.dba_note: Houston Power Washing Pro is a d/b/a of Dominion Digital Group.
business.category: Free pressure washing and soft washing referral phone line for the Houston area
business.hours_text: The phone line is answered 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by an automated assistant. Online requests are accepted any time.
business.description: Houston Power Washing Pro is a free phone line for Houston-area homeowners and businesses. Call (832) 662-4107 and an automated assistant takes down what needs cleaning, then puts you through to an independent, owner-run local pressure washing company that inspects, quotes, does the work and is paid by you directly.
business.short_disclosure: Houston Power Washing Pro is a free phone line, not a pressure washing company. It connects you with an independent local pressure washing company, which inspects, quotes, does the work and is paid by you directly.
business.referral_disclosure: Houston Power Washing Pro never charges callers. It may be paid a referral fee by the companies it connects callers with.
business.quote_text: I believe the unbelievable, I receive the impossible, because it's doable.

services.name: Residential Pressure Washing
services.card_alt: Concrete driveway being pressure washed in front of a brick house
services.summary: Driveways, walks, patios, pool decks and other hard surfaces around a Houston home, matched with a company that sizes the pressure to the surface.

services.name: House Washing and Soft Washing
services.card_alt: Technician soft washing the brick and siding of a two-story house
services.summary: Low-pressure soft washing for brick, fiber cement, vinyl and stucco, so green mildew and black streaks come off without forcing water behind the siding.

services.name: Roof Cleaning
services.card_alt: Roof half cleaned, showing the difference between stained and clean tiles
services.summary: Soft wash roof cleaning for the black streaks, moss and lichen that build up on Houston shingles, tile and metal roofs.

services.name: Driveway and Sidewalk Cleaning
services.card_alt: Freshly cleaned concrete driveway next to a green lawn
services.summary: Concrete driveways, front walks and curb strips cleaned with surface cleaners, plus treatment for tire marks, mildew and the dark band along the lawn edge.

services.name: Commercial Pressure Washing
services.card_alt: Worker pressure washing a sidewalk in front of a row of storefronts
services.summary: Storefronts, sidewalks, dumpster pads, drive-thrus and building exteriors for Houston businesses, with work that can be planned around opening hours.

services.name: Fence Cleaning
services.card_alt: Weathered wood privacy fence being washed with a spray wand
services.summary: Gray, mildewed wood fences brought back without furring the boards, plus vinyl and wrought iron fences.

services.name: Deck and Patio Cleaning
services.card_alt: Wood deck boards with patio furniture in evening sun
services.summary: Wood and composite decks, pavers and stamped concrete patios cleaned for the surface they are, with time to dry before any stain.

services.name: Gutter Cleaning and Brightening
services.summary: The black tiger stripes on the outside of gutters and fascia, often handled together with a house wash.

services.name: Oil and Rust Stain Removal
services.summary: Oil drips, fertilizer rust and orange irrigation stains on concrete, treated with the right product before any rinse.
